derivation: from G3844 (παρά) and the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);
def: side-marked, i.e. labelled (with a badge (figure-head) of a ship)

occurrences.text: And after three months we departed in a ship of Alexandria, which had wintered in the isle, whose sign was Castor and Pollux.
